0x0007E2.en: 「As I am now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000853.en: 「Gah!@　So this is as far as I go...!!」

0x0008DB.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A04.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A3C.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B05.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000B40.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000B94.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C08.en: 「Gah! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000C7E.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000CE5.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D17.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000D53.en: 「Nngh! Did they get the better of me...」

0x000D91.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DDE.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E1C.en: 「Eek, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E63.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F0E.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00104A.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010B7.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010FE.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001177.en: 「I can't fight any more! I'm pulling back!」

0x00121F.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm not ready...!」

0x00126D.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001328.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001357.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001395.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0013C4.en: 「I can't go on any longer. Do excuse me.」

0x001417.en: 「A shame... I'll have to fall back.」

0x00144F.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015B5.en: 「Bailing out...@ Ngh...! Not a good look...」

0x0017B3.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0017E2.en: 「So I've still got a way to go...!」

0x001907.en: 「The ship launches shortly.@ The Ruina will likely move in response to us.@ There's no telling when the sortie order will come.」

0x0019A0.en: 「Until we reach the Antarctic Circle,@ all hands stand by in your respective hangar ready rooms.」

0x001A93.en: 「Back when I was still a rookie, I was there for the <Antarctic Incident>.@ Got beaten black and blue by the Granzon.」

0x001B43.en: 「If Cybuster hadn't shown up back then,@ I'd have been a goner...」

0x001BD7.en: 「That machine... the Flickerei Geist,@ it seems to be on your mind.」

0x001C46.en: 「To think Alt's parts made their way all around@ and ended up bolted onto that machine...」

0x001CB7.en: 「They were ripped off by Axel's Soulgain,@ and I thought that was that... but the <Shadow-Mirror>@ recovered them.」

0x001D64.en: 「A spoil of war, maybe. And on top of that,@ they say the Flickerei Geist's core is a@ twice-recycled <Einst> part...」

0x001E0B.en: 「In a sense, like a distant cousin@ of Rein Weiss or Alt?」

0x001E79.en: 「Put it beside the Rein Weissritter --@ no reaction?」

0x001EDB.en: 「No... nor the Ryujinki. Everything's so@ mixed together it's become something else entirely.@ By the way, where's the cute pilot?」

0x001F86.en: 「I hear he's under watch along with Ing.@ Once Major Gilliam joins us,@ they'll hand him over, apparently...」

0x002025.en: （...Those two, they're Lieutenant Kyosuke Nanbu@ and Ensign Excellen Browning@ of the ATX Team, aren't they.）

0x0020B2.en: （The Steel Dragon Squadron's top-ace pair...@ They've got the presence to match.）

0x002105.en: 「Oh my, you... you're Ensign Aqua Centrum, aren't you?」

0x00218B.en: 「Of course I do.@ Word's gotten around that a newcomer's arrived@ who could be a gravure queen.」

0x002209.en: （S-so it really is that kind of talk...）

0x002249.en: 「I love a pilot suit like that.@ Isn't it just dashing?」

0x0022C7.en: 「Maybe I'll get mine redone too.@ Load it up with lots of see-through material.」

0x002344.en: 「A waste of the budget. I'm not signing off on it.」

0x00237E.en: 「Oh dear.@ Well then, see you around, Aqua.」

0x0023BC.en: （S-so cool... I could really look up to those two.）

0x00241B.en: 「Contact with us? @ The Gaia Sabers' flagship?」

0x002475.en: 「Yes. Direct orders from President Graien Grusman@ and Special Deputy Vice President@ Alteur Steinbeck themselves.」

0x002545.en: 「Is this about Ensign Ariel Org...@ or do they mean to run a joint operation@ with us in Antarctica?」

0x0025F0.en: 「If so, a simple transmission would suffice.」

0x002630.en: 「What shall we do?@ Shall we query the Joint Chiefs or Izu?」

0x00268C.en: 「If it's a presidential order,@ we can't very well ignore it.@ Change course at once... and notify the Hagane.」

0x002742.en: 「The Gaia Sabers fleet is entering our airspace.」

0x0027B3.en: 「The fleet's deploying... forming a ring formation.@ Not just horizontal -- above us too... This is odd.」

0x002943.en: 「Yes.@ ...Have you had a chance to confirm the item?」

0x002999.en: 「Ah, a Pulitzer Prize...@ no, we might just be within reach of the Palme d'Or.」

0x002A2C.en: 「Then, should the worst come to pass,@ the president will withdraw from this airspace.」

0x002A9A.en: 「A suggestion, sir.@ We should assign an escort now -- we can't rule out Guests@ or the Antarctic unknowns appearing in this airspace.」

0x002B54.en: 「It's vital that the president be present here.@ Even you don't expect the Steel Dragon Squadron@ to comply meekly, do you?」

0x002BF3.en: 「Sir... it was the same during Mission Halper.@ For all that they're soldiers,@ they tend to act on their own judgment.」

0x002CA4.en: 「Though... I had a period like that myself.」

0x002CF0.en: 「But you repented and stood here again.@ Serve the Gaia Sabers well, and your past is settled --@ then you can reclaim your name.」

0x002DCF.en: （Steel Dragon Squadron... Tetsuya Onodera...@ how will you people play this...?）

0x002E2E.en: 「Now then, open a channel to the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002E86.en: 「Captain, incoming transmission from the@ Gaia Sabers flagship, the Air Christmas.」

0x002F07.en: 「To the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ I am the commander of the Gaia Sabers,@ Alteur Steinbeck.」

0x002F82.en: 「I'm Colonel Lefina Enfield, commander of the@ Federation Far East Division's 1st Independent@ Special Task Squadron.」

0x002FFF.en: 「Commander Alteur,@ tell us why you wished to join up with us.」

0x003061.en: 「Very well.@ I bear the orders of the Federation President,@ His Excellency Graien Grusman.」

0x0030D0.en: 「As of this moment, the Steel Dragon Squadron is@ relieved of duty. Disarm now and hand over all your@ ships and mobile weapons to us.」

0x0031AA.en: 「Did you not hear me?@ We, the Gaia Sabers, are seizing@ every weapon you possess.」

0x00322E.en: 「Furthermore, Colonel Lefina Enfield and her officers@ will be held temporarily, to ensure the ships and@ weapons are seized smoothly.」

0x0032EB.en: 「Give us your reasons... let us hear your reasons!」

0x003328.en: 「The Steel Dragon Squadron left Federation command@ and went missing. In that time, you're suspected@ of contacting a hostile force.」

0x0033DD.en: 「The president was concerned by this, and judged@ that a strict inquiry was necessary.」

0x003445.en: 「Regarding the La Gias matter, we reported to both@ the Joint Chiefs and Izu Base Command!」

0x0034BF.en: 「We intended to follow Commander Kenneth Garret's@ orders and report to Izu to face the inquiry...!」

0x00354B.en: 「By the president's will, we, the Gaia Sabers, are@ to conduct the Steel Dragon Squadron's inquiry.」

0x0035CE.en: 「And so you demand we disarm, under circumstances like these...!」

0x00361A.en: 「Isn't what we should be doing right now@ stopping the Ruina and Guest invasions!?」

0x003697.en: 「Don't twist the issue.@ It's precisely because of circumstances like these@ that a force able to sway the war must be more strictly controlled.」

0x003761.en: （The pretext is outrageous. It's almost as if@ he's deliberately provoking us...）

0x0037C6.en: 「The president's thinking is this: a force like the@ Steel Dragon Squadron belongs not to the military,@ but under the highest authority...」

0x00385F.en: 「Wielding the PGS,@ it should move swiftly at the president's will.」

0x0038DD.en: 「^The privilege of the GAIA SABERS^...@ known as the GS Privilege.」

0x003925.en: 「A special right granted to swiftly carry out@ the president's special orders in military matters...」

0x00399C.en: 「It exists to form an armed body separate@ from the Federation forces, with the right to@ refuse any order from the military.」

0x003A3B.en: 「Then it can hardly guarantee you any@ authority to command us, the Federation forces...!」

0x003AD7.en: 「For that matter, has this GS Privilege even@ received the approval of the Federation Congress?」

0x003B58.en: 「Then your seizure order@ has no legal basis.」

0x003BCD.en: 「We cannot comply with disarmament here and now.@ We'll answer for everything after this mission ends,@ at Far East Division's Izu Base.」

0x003C93.en: 「After that, if you go through the proper channels,@ we'll defer to your wishes as well.」

0x003D04.en: （A foolish choice. Do you really think@ you can slip out of this situation?）

0x003D60.en: 「So you're saying you won't obey the Gaia Sabers'@ directive... you won't disarm?」

0x003DDD.en: 「As I said before... not now, not here.@ Not unless a formal order comes down through the@ Joint Chiefs and Far East Division Command.」

0x003E85.en: （If this buys us even a little time...）

0x003EBC.en: 「Surely you're aware the president is the@ supreme commander of the Federation forces?」

0x003F2A.en: 「...Then what of the president's War Powers Act?@ What of his duty to explain and report to Congress?」

0x003FA1.en: 「This is an emergency exception.@ Besides, we hold the president's special order documents.@ We'll report to Congress after the fact.」

0x00403A.en: 「Then let the president explain to us directly.」

0x00407A.en: （...Does the commander mean to keep the president@ off this channel entirely?）

0x0040D0.en: 「This is getting nowhere.@ Then, on this matter, I -- who've been vested with@ full authority by the president -- will...」

0x004157.en: 「We hereby carry out the compulsory seizure of the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x00419E.en: 「All forces. Should they resist, @　it will be deemed an act of rebellion against @　the President, and preemptive fire is authorized.」

0x00427C.en: 「Th-this is completely one-sided!@　This is utter madness!」

0x0042D8.en: 「Don't tell me... they meant this from the start...!」

0x004309.en: 「Yes. They intended to crush us all along.@　Perhaps they meant to follow proper procedure @　and handle it quietly at first, but...」

0x0043C0.en: 「At this rate, even if we disarm, we officers @　likely won't come out of this unharmed.」

0x004434.en: 「Do we accept the order, or resist?@　What's your call, Captain?」

0x0044A6.en: 「Alpha 1 to Saber 1 - Commander Alteur.@ Deployment complete... ready to launch anytime.」

0x004558.en: 「The situation has been relayed to the President 'accurately,' yes?」

0x0045C3.en: (Indeed. Using the footage we prepared in advance...)

0x004632.en: 「...Alteur.@　It seems the Steel Dragon Squadron has rebelled.」

0x004685.en: 「Yes.@　They did have something to hide, it seems.」

0x0046CF.en: 「I never thought they'd be so rash.@　It's just as you feared, Alteur.」

0x004755.en: (What is the President talking about...?@　The Steel Dragon Squadron requested an audience.)

0x0047C0.en: 「Very well - carry out the seizure. But the Steel Dragon Squadron are war heroes to the public. Avoid annihilating them.」

0x00488C.en: 「Minimize losses on both sides, force their surrender, @　and let me hear them out directly. Can you do it?」

0x004918.en: 「I am moved by your resolve, Mr. President.@　I will answer it with all my might.」

0x004989.en: 「Also, the President will withdraw from this airspace @　aboard his personal craft.」

0x0049EE.en: 「Understood. I leave the rest to you.」

0x004A16.en: 「...Captain. Begin threat fire on the Steel Dragon @　Squadron. No need to tighten the encirclement.」

0x004A81.en: 「That would give them time and risk letting @　them slip away.」

0x004AE6.en: 「Then let me hear the opinion of one who once @　served as captain of a Space Noah-class.」

0x004B57.en: 「The Hagane and Hiryu Kai will likely form a column and use <Tesla Drive> linkage for high-speed flight to escape this airspace.」

0x004C1C.en: 「Given the fight with the Unknown, and to spare @　our forces, the President should issue the order to @　the Steel Dragon Squadron directly.」

0x004CD3.en: 「A textbook answer.@　But even so, I don't believe they'll @　comply so meekly.」

0x004D45.en: 「I doubt they'd be foolish enough to defy the @　President to his face.」

0x004DB6.en: 「You never know.@ Even a cornered rat can turn and bite.」

0x004E03.en: (Wasn't the whole point of bringing the President @　here to force the Steel Dragon Squadron to yield?)

0x004E83.en: (And the President didn't seem to grasp the @　situation accurately...)

0x004EF1.en: 「Captain. Per the President's order, minimize @　losses on both sides and force the Steel Dragon @　Squadron to surrender.」

0x004F78.en: 「As I said, no need to tighten the encirclement.@　Don't provoke them needlessly.」

0x004FF3.en: 「Captain,@ the Gaia Sabers ships are moving to attack!」

0x005049.en: 「Colonel Lefina,@　we of the Kurogane will sortie and hold them off.@　Use the time to escape this airspace.」

0x005107.en: 「Yes.@ From what Gilliam and Ariel Org report,@ there's much about the Gaia Sabers that's suspect...」

0x0051A3.en: 「I'll use my connections and Gilliam's with the@ Federation Assembly. Let's push through, gather@ evidence, then fight them where it counts.」

0x00526F.en: 「That... I'd considered it too.@ But I cannot authorize a sortie here, nor any @ attack or counterattack against the Gaia Sabers.」

0x00531A.en: 「You want to shed any factor that could hurt us @　later? Then the Hiryu Kai and Hagane will bear @　the brunt of a concentrated assault.」

0x0053C8.en: 「Their aim is to seize our forces' weapons.@　If they meant to wipe us out, they'd have @　already made their move.」

0x0054A1.en: 「To a degree.@　We'll use that against them and weather it with @　the E-Field until we break away.」

0x005522.en: 「Besides, if we launch each unit, they'll be left @　behind by the Formation Breakout's @　high-speed flight.」

0x0055D3.en: 「We can only endure with this ship and the Hagane @　and carve out a way through.@　Are you with me, Lt. Commander Tetsuya?」

0x0056B0.en: 「I see. We secure an acceleration corridor @　through the gap in their encirclement.」

0x00570C.en: 「Yes, we must reach it before they close the net.@ But all attacks and counterattacks on the @ Gaia Sabers are strictly forbidden!」

0x0057F4.en: 「The Air Christmas's turrets @　are trained on us!!」

0x0058C5.en: 「Commander, the Hagane and Hiryu Kai are @　heading for the gap in the encirclement.」

0x005924.en: 「They're aiming to escape via high-speed flight.@　We'll tighten the net and stop them.」

0x0059A1.en: 「I told you not to provoke them needlessly.」

0x005A16.en: (Is the Commander telling us to let the Steel @　Dragon Squadron escape...?)

0x005A5C.en: 「Both ships have reached the target point.」

0x005B61.en: 「That formation...!@　Concentrate fire on their propulsion units!」

0x005BBD.en: (This went better than I expected.@　Checkmate.)

0x005C81.en: 「Heat sources below the surface, beneath the ship!@　Count: 8! They're surfacing!」

0x005D0C.en: 「The Guests! At a time like this!」

0x005D37.en: 「Alpha 1 to all units.@　Don't lay a hand on the Urchins until I order it.」

0x005DE0.en: 「Charge through and scatter them! Continue the count!」

0x005E42.en: 「Th-the President's craft is launching from the aft deck!!」

0x005E88.en: 「Impossible, at a time like this!?@　Stop him at once!!」

0x005F03.en: 「Here we go! All hands, brace for impact!」

0x005F5C.en: 「Wh-what is the meaning of this!?@　Why did you let him launch!? Alteur!!」

0x005FCA.en: 「C-Captain! A transport ship dead ahead!@　Distance 800!!」
